name: Blast Mine's Remote Detonation comes and goes without a chat line, a new button or an unlearn (#3965)
contract: AscensionTinker::Refresh (every 500 ms from the Tinker player update, AscensionTinker.cpp:388-393) teaches Remote
Detonation 801798 with learnSpell(801798, true) while a Blast Mine 50045 is live and removes it with
removeSpell(801798, SPEC_MASK_ALL, true) once no mine is left (AscensionTinker.cpp:348-354). It is a plain
temporary learn, not a swap. Every deploy used to print 'You have learned a new spell' and place another Remote
Detonation on an empty button, and every detonation printed 'You have unlearned'. With
CoA.TemporarySpellReplacement.Silent the learn is quiet (SpellCustomAttr row 25250 pushed with the quiet-learn
bit), the removal never reaches the client (the spell stays in the client's spellbook as a swapped-out
replacement does, Player::SendLearnPacket), no SMSG_SUPERCEDED_SPELL is sent, and a Remote Detonation cast while
no mine exists is refused by HandleCastSpellOpcode with SPELL_FAILED_CASTER_AURASTATE (22, SharedDefines.h:1066)
before the spellbook check. Expected over two mines: zero chat lines for 801798, client_knows_spell 1 after the
last mine is gone while the server no longer knows it, an empty button still empty, one SMSG_LEARNED_SPELL and
one client spellbook copy over both mines (the second learn is not re-sent while the client still holds the
spell, #436), and cast_failure 22 for the idle cast.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Deploy Blast Mine
SETUP: Remote Detonation is unknown before any mine exists
SETUP: the login bar was sent and button 120 is empty
Deploy a mine 1 yd from the golem
One Blast Mine is placed
The live mine grants Bomb Ready
Remote Detonation is taught while the mine is live
The client holds Remote Detonation
Learning Remote Detonation printed nothing
Detonate the mine
The mine is gone
The server drops Remote Detonation with the last mine
The client keeps Remote Detonation instead of an unlearned line
The removal printed nothing
Deploy a second mine
A second Blast Mine is placed
The second mine grants Bomb Ready
Remote Detonation is taught again
The second mine did not announce Remote Detonation again
The client holds exactly one copy of Remote Detonation
The client still holds Remote Detonation
The second learn printed nothing
Let the global cooldown pass
Detonate the second mine
The second mine is gone
The server drops Remote Detonation again
The client keeps Remote Detonation after the last mine
Zero chat lines for Remote Detonation over both mines
No SMSG_SUPERCEDED_SPELL was sent
An empty button stays empty
Let the global cooldown pass
Remote Detonation with no mine
The idle cast is refused with SPELL_FAILED_CASTER_AURASTATE
The refused cast printed nothing either
The Tinker is unharmed
